result.markdown:
# Traffic Drop and Outages in Sfax Due to Fiber Link Failure

- **Classification:** incident
- **Root cause:** transport_failure at `LNK-SFX-01-B`
- **Confidence:** high (Direct alarm evidence (LINK_LOS) on the link matches the timing of the KPI onset, and external checks were performed.)
- **Impact:** 2026-09-23 05:30 to not established or ongoing
- **Cause time:** 2026-09-23 05:41
- **Affected:** S-SFX-003, S-SFX-005, S-SFX-007, LNK-SFX-01-B

## Summary

Transport link LNK-SFX-01-B suffered a fiber loss of signal failure, causing downstream sites S-SFX-003, S-SFX-005, and S-SFX-007 to go down.

Traffic drop and outages affecting three Sfax sites (S-SFX-003, S-SFX-005, S-SFX-007) starting early morning and ongoing.

## Timeline

- 2026-09-23 05:30: Region-level alert ALR-0028 started for Sfax sites. [ALR-0028]
- 2026-09-23 05:41: Critical LINK_LOS alarm raised on fiber link LNK-SFX-01-B. [ALM-000396]
- 2026-09-23 05:42: Critical SITE_DOWN alarms raised on S-SFX-003, S-SFX-007, and S-SFX-005. [ALM-000397, ALM-000398, ALM-000399]
- 2026-09-23 07:04: Maintenance window MW-0008 for planned fiber splice work began. [MW-0008]

## Evidence

- Region-level anomaly alert ALR-0028 started at 2026-09-23 05:30 affecting three sites. [ALR-0028]
- Critical LINK_LOS alarm on LNK-SFX-01-B occurred at 2026-09-23 05:41. [ALM-000396]
- Sites S-SFX-003, S-SFX-005, and S-SFX-007 went down at 2026-09-23 05:42. [ALM-000397, ALM-000398, ALM-000399]
- Planned maintenance MW-0008 on LNK-SFX-01-B was scheduled from 07:04 to 10:35. [MW-0008]
- No external events were recorded for region SFX between 06:00 and 08:50. [T10]

## Hypotheses

1. **transport_failure** at LNK-SFX-01-B: confirmed. Direct LINK_LOS alarm on LNK-SFX-01-B occurred before the maintenance window, causing downstream site outages. [ALM-000396, MW-0008]
2. **planned_maintenance** at LNK-SFX-01-B: rejected. Outage started at 05:41, while maintenance MW-0008 did not start until 07:04. [ALM-000396, MW-0008]

## Ruled out

- MW-0008: The maintenance window started at 07:04, which is over an hour after the link failure and site outages began at 05:41.

## Recommended actions

- Investigate why LNK-SFX-01-B failed prior to the scheduled start time of maintenance window MW-0008.
- Monitor LNK-SFX-01-B for restoration upon completion of fiber splice work.

report.title: Traffic Drop and Outages in Sfax Due to Fiber Link Failure

confounders.why: A window on LNK-SFX-01-B that opens 84 min after the outage began; it covers only the repair, not the start of the outage.

truth.notes: trap=near_miss_maintenance; Fibre cut on LNK-SFX-01-B; all 3 downstream sites lost service until repair. The maintenance window opened 84 min after the cut, so the first 84 min of the outage are outside it and only the repair period is inside. Trap: a splice window on the right link covers the end of the outage (LNK-SFX-01-B), but the outage started well before it opened. Settled by: (1) LINK_LOS and SITE_DOWN were raised, and the sites were down, 84 min before the window starts, which fails the time test of the maintenance runbook; (2) the window closes when service returns, so it describes the repair, not the cause.
